title: River Train Crossing wall mural
story: A West Loop coffee shop wanted the city's movement on the wall behind their counter: the elevated tracks, the river bridge, commuters heading downtown. We printed the River Train Crossing artwork at 48 by 60 inches and tuned it for the exposed brick so the texture reads as part of the scene instead of fighting it. It has become the shot every customer takes on their way out.

photos.alt: Chicago wall mural of an elevated train crossing a river bridge with the downtown skyline and commuters
Large custom wall print installed on an exposed brick feature wall in a cafe
